collections.name: Starter pack
collections.description: Three templates to get a fresh instance moving: an inbound webhook, a scheduled database export, and an error alert. Each one works without any custom nodes.

collections.name: DevX Message Connector scenarios
collections.description: Eleven manual-run examples covering Text, HTML, Adaptive Card, Generic, Rocket.Chat, GitHub pull requests and workflow runs, Backup Container, Sysdig, StatusCake, and Uptime.com. Every example uses Preview mode, which calls the configured DevX preview endpoint without posting to Teams.
